AUDIO IMPORTANT:

if there is no audio in your video-in then it errors. 

If you have silent video, you will need to provide audio in of some kind to run the workflow, even if you dont include it in the output video. Use the audio loader to load in a random mp3 (e.g. 10 seconds of music or ambient silence) and set duration to match your inbound video. swithc the audio vae encoder to use this not the video. This should then work.

NOTE: I found if I prompt for "non_diegetic_music:" it will then use it rather than the audio, so make sure to put "N/A" in any audio descriptors for the prompt if you want to keep the audio you are loading in.

# PROMPTS:

## Default One Person Face Swap:

<Subject 1> is the character represented in <Picture 1>. The video is a close up face of <Subject 1>.

## Targeting Two People This Worked Great:

<Subject 1> is the character represented in <Picture 1>. <Subject 2> is the character represented in <Picture 2>. The video is of <Subject 2> ending a ballet move on a stage, she exits the stage and pauses briefly beside <Subject 1> to kiss her on the cheek. The camera moves in to follow <Subject 2> leaving the stage, and ends on a close-up of the face of <Subject 1>.

## Targetting full body of 1 person (worked but the box around the cropping was messy blending back in):

<Subject 1> is the character depicted in <Picture 1>. Create a video where <Subject 1> is pictured as the primary character in the final video.

## Targetting just the man's suit (this worked okay, but masking slipped to the head a bit at end and didnt fix box crop visual shade issues):

<Subject 1> is the character depicted in <Picture 1>. Create a video where <Subject 1> is wearing the blue suit shown in <Picture 1>.

# MarkDKBerry.com

*The original workflow comes from AbleJones (drozbay) and the masking is now part of comfyui core* 

His workflow and further info on this workflow method from drozbay in the PR here [https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15375](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15375)

Must install custom node [https://github.com/drozbay/MaskVidExperiments](https://github.com/drozbay/MaskVidExperiments)

---

**Updated**: 30th August 2026 (AEST).

For more of my adaptations check

YT Channel: [https://www.youtube.com/@markdkberry](https://www.youtube.com/@markdkberry)

Patreon: [https://www.patreon.com/c/AIMakingMovies](https://www.patreon.com/c/AIMakingMovies)

Github: [https://github.com/mdkberry/comfyui_workflows](https://github.com/mdkberry/comfyui_workflows)

---

## MB TESTS

This works well for single faces and heads.

It even works for targetting two people's faces, but will crop the entire space between them.

I ran into minor crop-stitch issues when targetting full bodies. There was a shadow following the character as he walked, and though I was able to solve it by targetting specific cloth items rather than entire body, the crop getting stitched back in showed the box of the crop. This is likely to do with using mp4 compression in and outbound. I haven't yet tested using lossless Prores video save type, but AJ suggested that as the cure.



---
